whyItMatters: x.execute passes its argument to command execution in groovy, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace x.execute with list .execute() with separate arguments, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no x.execute call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no x.execute reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
